The '''Purple Mushroom''' can be found:
*via [[foraging]] on [[The Mines#The Mushroom Floor|Mushroom Floors]] in [[The Mines]] (chance to spawn on floors 81-119).
*via [[foraging]] in [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|the dangerous mines]] (floors 41-49) or the [[Skull Cavern]].
*at a tapped or chopped [[Mushroom Tree]].
*grown in [[The Cave|the Farm Cave]] if converted for mushrooms (2.5% chance).
*as a possible gift at the [[Feast of the Winter Star]] from any adult except Clint, Evelyn, Marnie, Robin, or Willy.
*occasionally in a [[Garbage Can]] after the player has reached floor 40 of the Mines.
*occasionally at the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|250}}.
*through the mail from the [[Wizard]] at any [[friendship]] level greater than zero friendship points.
*on the [[Farm Maps|Forest Farm Map]] during [[Fall]] (25% chance).
*in the [[Ginger Island#Dig Site|Ginger Island mushroom cave]].
*on a [[Mushroom Log]].

==Bundles==
*Purple Mushroom is used in the {{Bundle|Field Research||y}}.
*Purple Mushroom is one of the options for the {{Bundle|Exotic||y}}. 
*Five Purple Mushrooms are one of the options for the {{Bundle|Wild Medicine||y}}.

==Tailoring==
Purple Mushroom is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] with [[Cloth]] in the feed to create a {{Name|Shirt099|link=Tailoring{{!}}Shirt|class=inline}}. It is a purple dye when used in the spool of the Sewing Machine with a dyeable clothing item in the feed. It can be placed in the purple dye pot at Emily's and Haley's house for use in [[dyeing]].

==Quests==
*After the player reaches the bottom of [[the Mines]], one Purple Mushroom may be randomly requested during any season at the [[Quests#Help Wanted Quests|"Help Wanted" board]] outside [[Pierre's General Store]] for a reward of {{Price|750}} and 150 [[Friendship]] points. 
*2-3 Purple Mushrooms may be requested by [[Catfish]], [[Octopus]], [[Rainbow Trout]], [[Spook Fish]], or [[Super Cucumber]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 5 to 7.
